thread:
cari (product): Quick announcement — we're shifting the hosted API metering window from a sliding 60s bucket to a fixed 30s 'meter clock' for token accounting, and enabling a short invoice-hold + reconciliation mode for affected customers during the cutover. Rollout scheduled TOMORROW 2026-04-01 06:00 UTC. (Yes, it's aggressive; read the playbook below).
emily (finance): Why 30s fixed vs 60s sliding? impact to revenue recognition? :thinking:
raj (billing): Main reason is smoothing burst accounting and avoiding overcharging on microbursts. Reconciliation mode will ensure we don't generate invoices for any customer with >5% variance vs current billing this month.
kai (eng-infra): Tech note: this requires runtime change to the aggregator shard and a config flip on the metering service. I've tested locally; will need canary in us-west-2 first. Also adding extra telemetry for per-route deltas.
ben (cto): Important: keep backwards compatibility for API rate-limit headers. Customers should not see a harder limit, only different meter sampling. Fallback plan: rollback meter-clock within 30m if error rate >0.5%.
sofia (support): Draft customer msg please — we need a clear FAQ and a triage checklist. We'll need a private opt-out for enterprise accounts that can't tolerate any small deltas.
emily (finance): Reconciliation mode timeline: hold invoices for 24h for accounts flagged in the variance band, create provisional invoice after reconciliation, and send an audit email. Legal signed off on provisional invoice language.
raj (billing): Key operational rules:
- Any account with computed invoice delta >$100 or >10% gets manual review.
- Auto-adjust for credits to match previous month on first reconciliation.
- Flag recurring anomalies to SRE.
cari (product): Playbook (short):
1) 06:00 UTC: flip meter-clock config in canary cluster (us-west-2-canary)
2) 06:15: monitor token delta & error budget, if OK → 10% rollout to us-west-2
3) 06:45: if stable then 50% → global ramp over 2 hours
4) If variance triggers, enable invoice-hold for affected accounts and notify Finance & Support
5) After 24h reconcile, publish provisional invoice and send audit email

Attachables: support FAQ draft, reconciliation script snippet, rollback steps.
ops-bot: deploy scheduled: metering-service v3.4.1 -> us-west-2-canary at 2026-04-01T06:00:00Z. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/meter-clock-rollout
kai (eng-infra): Snippet for the reconciliation script (will push to infra repo):
```
# pseudo
for acct in flagged_accounts:
  old = compute_old_bill(acct)
  new = compute_new_bill(acct)
  if abs(new-old)/old > 0.05:
    hold_invoice(acct)
    notify(finance, support, acct)
  else:
    emit_provisional_invoice(acct)
```
sofia (support): Customer comms draft: "We're adjusting how token usage is batched to better reflect real-time usage. During the rollout some customers may see small invoice adjustments; eligible accounts will get a provisional invoice and the option for a manual review." Thoughts?
emily (finance): Add explicit language about credits and no-double-billing guarantee. Also add contact for expedited review.
raj (billing): I've added a dashboard: Billing -> MeterClockCutover showing per-account delta, flagged list, and hold status.
ben (cto): Two asks: 1) telemetry retention for these metrics = 90 days minimum; 2) add a binary kill-switch in the control plane we can hit without a deploy.
kai (eng-infra): Will do. Kill-switch exposed as feature-flag and tested in canary.
sofia (support): Please ping #support-alerts when we flip canary and again when we enable invoice-hold for any accounts. We'll standby for high-touch customers.
emily (finance): Post-rollout follow-ups: accounting will publish a short reconciliation report and a list of manually adjusted invoices within 72h.
cari (product): Thanks all. I'll post the FAQ + canned replies in this thread by EOD and coordinate with comms for external emails. @ops-bot, please post status updates during the rollout.
ops-bot: acknowledged. I'll post: canary-started, canary-stable, global-ramp, invoice-hold-enabled, rollback-executed as events.
raj (billing): One more: temporarily waive late-fee triggers for any provisional invoices created because of this rollout. Finance confirmed.
ben (cto): Good. Let's limit blast radius and keep manual review conservative. :thumbsup:
sofia (support): On it — we have standby rotation for tomorrow 06:00-12:00 UTC.
cari (product): Final note: internal docs & runbook link: https://redwood.internal/docs/meter-clock-cutover — use that as single source-of-truth."
